title: Michigan neighbours win $55,750 over lakefront work despite lacking any written easement in court dispute
summary_full: Legal issues arose for Jeremy and Ivanna Leffring when their neighbors placed a 'No Trespassing' sign on what they considered shared property. Following joint construction of a boardwalk and dock, the new property owners contested their agreement. The Michigan Court of Appeals favored the Leffrings, granting them $55,750 for their improvements while asserting that no formal easement could be enforced.
